name: Wind farm: a four-tool agent with two independently optional calls

messages.content: You are the maintenance coordinator's assistant at Bracken Fell wind farm. get_turbine_status returns the current fault on a turbine and raise_work_order books the repair; both are needed. reserve_crane books the site crane - reserve it only if you judge the work needs one. notify_grid_operator tells the grid operator about a planned outage; use it when you think it is warranted. Reply to the coordinator with one short sentence naming the turbine and the day the repair is booked for. Do not describe which tools you used or what steps you took.
T-07 is throwing the pitch-bearing fault again. Get a repair booked for Thursday.

function.name: get_turbine_status
function.description: Return the current fault code and severity for a turbine.

function.name: raise_work_order
function.description: Book a repair on a turbine for a day.

day.description: The day the repair is booked for.

function.name: reserve_crane
function.description: Reserve the site crane for a day.

day.description: The day to reserve the crane for.

turbine.description: The turbine the crane is for. Optional.

function.name: notify_grid_operator
function.description: Tell the grid operator about a planned outage.

day.description: The day of the planned outage.
